decisions.rationale: Compared all 212 comparators. FileSafe adversarial-test coverage and the explicit GUI permission-policy owner are relevant to negative-policy assurance, but neither has the web-agent fixture's authority, invariant set, state boundary, or failure oracles.

Compared all 212 comparators. These entries concern revocation, approval-card timing, image-ingestion grants, or web-session races, but each is a narrower or different permission lifecycle than the fixture-wide web permission state contract.

Compared all 212 comparators. Untrusted rendered previews, visualizer bridge messages, and webview embedding are adjacent hostile-input surfaces; none governs URL reading and browser evidence across redirects, DNS, private networks, prompt injection, downloads, and exfiltration.
